GSLE reproduction notes, 2026-11-05

Paper: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2025/papers/Xiao_Localized_Gaussian_Splatting_Editing_with_Contextual_Awareness_WACV_2025_paper.pdf
Supplement: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2025/supplemental/Xiao_Localized_Gaussian_Splatting_WACV_2025_supplemental.pdf
Author project: https://corneliushsiao.github.io/GSLE.html

Primary sources: WACV 2025 paper pp.5207-5217 and its 7-page supplement,
downloaded to references/gsle. The author project page currently has no public
source-code link. This is an independent paper-derived implementation using
official component repositories, not an official GSLE code release.

Task: replace the complete machine (black assembly and white base) at the
previous input-video reference around75s with a yellow six-axis industrial
robot arm mounted on a metal base. Re-localize using a trained LangSplat
language field; the previous manually selected white-housing ROI is not input.

Paper method:
- Localization: LangSplat [39], paper p.5210. Train original SAM/OpenCLIP
  multiscale features, scene-wise512->3 autoencoder, and 3D language fields.
- AVP:100 azimuth views,3.6-degree spacing (p.5212). Target-masked HSV V,
  min/max contrast normalization,8 in-plane rotations separated by45degrees.
  Seek strongest directional brightness difference, not just brightest frame.
- Anchor inpainting: projected3D bounding-box mask, depth ControlNet, SD
  inpainting, generation text. SAM extracts generated foreground.
- Coarse: solid-sphere initialization, radially Gaussian-shaped opacity,
  low initial opacity/color, compactness-based densification/pruning from
  GSGen [7]. Optimize RGB MSE, rendered-opacity mask MSE, and Stable Zero123
  3D-SDS (paper equations3-4). Freeze pretrained models.
- Composition: remove old target Gaussians, retain all other scene parameters;
  place new object using an explicit invertible local-to-world similarity.
- Refinement: render combined object/background. Volumetric depth is based
  on camera-center distance (equation2), normalized then inverted as1-d.
  Depth ControlNet receives noisy4-channel RGB latents, time, text and depth
  (eq5). Its residuals enter9-channel inpainting UNet together with noisy
  latents, projected bbox mask, and masked-image latents (eq6).
  CFG in eq7 is conditioned + s*(conditioned - unconditioned).
  Use view-conditioned prompts; remove Zero123 loss in refinement (eq8).
  The unedited background stays frozen; gradients update the new object.

Supplement settings:
- Coarse random render64/128/256 and reference128/256/512 at steps0/200/300.
- Refinement random/reference512. Effective batch coarse6, refinement4.
- CFG coarse3.0; DI-SDS100. Models frozen. Memory microbatching may be used
  with summed/averaged gradients and one optimizer update per full batch.
- Coarse RGB/mask weights0->1500 over first1000 steps, then1000; 3D-SDS1.
- Refinement RGB/mask1500, DI-SDS0.1.
- Coarse xyz LR1e-3->1e-5 exponentially by1000; scale5e-3->5e-4.
- Refinement xyz1e-4->1e-5 by10000; scale5e-4->5e-5.
- Both stages rotation5e-3, color1e-2, opacity1e-2.

Published ambiguities to expose in configuration/records:
1. Supplement Algorithm1 writes B=abs(min(S-1)),argmin(B), but its stated
   objective and main-paper Fig.3 select maximal directional contrast. With
   complementary rotations, literal scoring can favor balanced illumination.
   Save literal scores and text-consistent contrast scores, with both selected
   views; explicitly record the scoring rule used for actual generation.
2. Supplement mentions3500 coarse iterations in1.2 and6500 in1.3. Use6500
   for the main run and save an intermediate3500 checkpoint; refinement2000.
3. The coarse RGB/mask schedule explicitly rises to1500 then stays at1000.
   Keep that piecewise schedule and record it rather than silently smoothing.
4. Paper does not specify every initialization constant, timestep range,
   candidate-camera radius/elevation, mask threshold, or densification period.
   Derive spatial settings from the data, reuse documented official component
   defaults where appropriate, and label each remaining choice as an assumption.
5. Runway's original SD model repository has migrated; use verified maintained
   snapshots of the same SD1.5 inpainting architecture. Stable Zero123 uses the
   DreamGaussian-supported diffusers conversion, not Zero123-XL or Zero123++.
6. SAM requires prompts. Automatic box/mask proposals must come from model
   outputs or projected geometry, never manual tracing or hand-made foregrounds.
7. Eq7 writes the unconditional prediction as epsilon_phi(x_t;t), omitting
   text, mask, context and depth. The primary implementation therefore uses
   empty text plus zero mask/context channels and zero ControlNet residuals.
   Nine input channels are still required by the inpainting UNet. This padding
   detail is not published; retain an explicit text-only-CFG ablation option.
8. World up is estimated automatically from LangSplat floor semantics and a
   robust plane, with calibrated-camera fallbacks. Semantic floor Gaussians
   coplanar with that plane are retained during target removal. This is an
   industrial-scene adaptation, not a claimed GSLE-published hyperparameter.
   The observed noisy floor required a strong-horizontal-plane acceptance
   case (>=1000 inliers, >20% support, normal/up alignment>0.95), followed by
   refitting within three initial residual tolerances. Original rejected fit
   and bbox-only removal diagnostics are retained. Unobserved background under
   the old machine is not fabricated; the paper keeps background points fixed.
9. Random-camera sampling follows the paper-era threestudio source pinned in
   camera_source.json:50/50 uniform-angle and sphere sampling, stratified
   azimuth, variable40-70degree FOV, and camera/center/up perturbations. The
   normalized radius is mapped relative to the selected anchor in scene units.
   Foreground background is white for Stable Zero123, as in DreamGaussian's
   image-to-3D workflow; GSLE does not publish that compositing constant.
10. Frozen diffusion networks use FP16, following the imported DreamGaussian
    execution path; Gaussian parameters/rendering and SDS loss accumulation
    use FP32. The paper does not specify numerical precision. SDS uses
    w(t)=1-alpha_cumprod(t), matching DreamGaussian's released guidance;
    GSLE leaves this weighting function unspecified. Report measured memory
    and timings for this implementation, not the paper's hardware figures.
11. Actual industrial-scene inpainting initially produced elongated mechanical
    parts rather than a recognizable arm. These failed outputs are retained.
    Require>=90% target visibility for AVP. Keep old-device localization/deletion
    separate from a derived upright generation volume: preserve the original
    floor-aligned horizontal extents and bottom, raise height to the largest
    original oriented extent. No coordinates or foregrounds are hand supplied.
    Inpainting ControlNet strength/prompt are adapted in config.json; use three
    fixed seeds and automatic OpenCLIP ranking followed by visual QA. Negative
    prompts apply only to2D generation; DI-SDS still uses empty unconditional
    text and its full depth residuals. These are disclosed industrial adapters,
    not hyperparameters reported by GSLE. AVP,3D-SDS and DI-SDS remain intact.
12. Box-only SAM included a generated cabinet behind the arm. The final SAM
    prompts use distance-transform peaks of yellow components and a large
    low-saturation component inside the preliminary SAM mask. These are
    automatic point prompts for this explicitly yellow target, not final mask
    pixels. SAM predicts the full foreground and candidates must contain the
    positive points and exclude the background point. Save all prompts/masks.
    The local sphere has radius0.5 (diameter1); its similarity scale maps that
    diameter to the largest generation-region side. A short earlier half-scale
    diagnostic is retained separately and is not the production coarse model.
13. Actual early refinement under drop_all_eq7 brightened/softened the object
    and increased reference losses. Run a separately isolated full2000-step
    text_only unconditional-conditioning ablation from the same coarse model.
    Installed diffusers0.30.3 ControlNet inpainting duplicates both mask and
    masked-image latents across CFG branches (pipeline_controlnet_inpaint.py,
    lines932-934); with guess_mode=False its ControlNet receives both text
    branches and the duplicated depth condition (lines1380-1406). This supports
    testing context-preserving empty-text conditioning for the paper's omitted
    unconditional inputs. Both experiments retain GSLE's cond+s*(cond-uncond)
    coefficient, all models, losses, schedules, inputs and iteration counts.
    This is a documented ambiguity comparison, not a claim of access to the
    authors' undisclosed implementation. Judge final actual renders separately.

Limitations acknowledged by the paper: no physically correct relighting or
background-shadow editing; visibility/camera trajectories can need adjustment;
single-view generation can miss lighting information. Record actual outcomes.
